description: Capture the workspace baseline and validate Codex changes through the existing governance enforcement fabric. Review and trust these hooks before use.

hooks.commandWindows: & { try { $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $hookInput = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Repository root unavailable' }; $env:PYTHONPATH = Join-Path $root 'src'; $hookInput | & ('C:/vscode-projects/ai4binance/.venv/Scripts/python.exe') -B (Join-Path $root 'scripts/codex_governance_hook.py'); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 2 } } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine(('CODEX_GOVERNANCE_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED | config=C:/vscode-projects/ai4binance/.codex/hooks.json | cwd={0} | root={1} | error={2} | errorId={3}' -f (Get-Location).Path, $root, $_.Exception.Message, $_.FullyQualifiedErrorId)); exit 2 } }
hooks.statusMessage: Verifying repository authority and production instructions
